tagline: Outdoor power equipment for forestry, farming and home
heroSubheading: Stock, service and advice for every outdoor power need
aboutHtml:
Gaye and Russell Hoskins have run STIHL SHOP Tokoroa for years, serving locals who know their equipment. We're an expert team committed to getting the right gear in your hands, whether you're clearing a property, maintaining a farm, or keeping your home tidy.

We stock the major brands that work. STIHL, Masport, Honda, Cub Cadet, Briggs & Stratton, John Deere, Hansa and Walker cover everything from chainsaws and trimmers to lawnmowers and generators. We service what we sell, and we can order what we don't have on the shelf.

Come in to the shop, or order online for Click & Collect or Home Delivery. We specialise in serving forestry, farming, commercial and domestic customers with all their outdoor power needs.
